summary: The hybrid worker now keeps itself up to date safely, and rolls back by itself if an update fails.

new.title: Hybrid worker updates itself daily
new.text: Each worker moves once a day to the version your installation runs, never ahead and never back. It installs only releases Invardia signed.
new.action: On each hybrid worker installed before 2.0.102, run the hybrid worker install once more; the server needs outbound HTTPS to invardia.com.

new.title: Failed updates roll back by themselves
new.text: The new version is set up next to the old one and tests itself. If the test fails, the worker switches back on its own.

new.title: Hybrid worker page shows last update
new.text: The Hybrid worker page now shows each worker's last daily update.
